column3: MT 76:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew.
“His lair” is rendered “His tabernacle,” and “His den” as “His dwelling place.”
“The flames of the bow” is rendered “the flaming arrows,” and “battle” as “the weapons of war.”
Close to the Hebrew; “lighted up” is rendered “resplendent.”
Close to the Hebrew; “did not find their hands” is rendered “could use his hands.”
“Sleeping were chariot and horse” is rendered “Both rider and horse were cast into a dead sleep.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the awesome one” is rendered “Him who is to be feared.”
